Project-authored MIT PE32 fixture; rebuild with `npm run build:owner-combos`.

`npm run test:owner-combos` uploads the unchanged native executable into Chromium. Native callbacks validate combo text/popup measurement, fixed/raw sorting, variable Unicode rows, real edit/list HWNDs, subclass forwarding, clipped HDC drawing, item data, notifications, sizing and deletion. Browser interaction checks programmatic opening, mouse/keyboard selection, cancellation, editable text, disabled controls and a popup outside its parent window.
